programme.desc: 'S9/E6 - Retro Love'. The bakers go retro as they celebrate the '50s and '60s. They make soda shop cupcakes and shaggy cakes dedicated to all those groovy lovers out there.

programme.title: The Kitchen
programme.desc: 'S33/E9 - Chef Swap'. The hosts trade places and cook dishes in each other's style. Katie Lee Biegel makes a salad with ingredients that represent her fellow co-hosts.

programme.title: Chopped
programme.desc: 'S53/E2 - More Cheese, Please!'. The chefs find cheese in every basket and have to make it the star of every plate. A wild comfort food hybrid proves challenging in round two.

programme.title: Halloween Cookie Challenge
programme.desc: 'S2/E3 - Slice & Bake And 3D Mirror'. Four bakers tackle tricky slice and bake cookies and get cracking on 3D haunted mirrors with something spooky trapped inside!

programme.title: Spring Baking Championship
programme.desc: 'S10/E3 - Awards Springing Up Everywhere'. It's awards season, so host Jesse Palmer asks the bakers to whip up award-envelope berry pies and cocktail-inspired 'bubble' cakes.

programme.title: Spring Baking Championship
programme.desc: 'S10/E4 - Earth Day: Inspired By Bugs!'. Jesse Palmer wants to pay homage to planet Earth and its creatures, so he asks the bakers to create an elevated plated dessert inspired by an insect.

programme.title: Guy's Grocery Games
programme.desc: 'S21/E2 - Scratch Chef Showdown'. Four chefs must make each component of their dishes from scratch. Which of the competitors will impress the judges and win the $20,000 shopping spree?

programme.title: Flavortown Food Fight
programme.desc: 'S1/E7 - Bowling Day'. The returning champion takes on Martel Stone and Evelyn Garcia as the chefs are challenged to leave the plates behind and serve everything in a bowl.

programme.title: Chopped Next Gen
programme.desc: 'S1/E1 - Young and Hungry'. Four young, hip and hungry chefs bring their top culinary skills and fierce determination to the kitchen. They face scorpion powder in round one!

programme.title: Guy's Grocery Games
programme.desc: 'S30/E11 - Cooking The Books'. Chef Antonia Lofaso gives four of Guy Fieri's superfans the chance to cook their favourite chef's recipes on his home turf - and there are some twisted games!

programme.title: Maneet's Eats
programme.desc: 'S1/E1 - Chicken Tikka Masala And Aloo Gobi'. Maneet Chauhan is cooking up her signature shortcut recipe for a classic chicken tikka masala, followed by a vegetarian feast of aloo gobi.

programme.title: Maneet's Eats
programme.desc: 'S1/E2 - Samosas And Pork Vindaloo'. Maneet Chauhan prepares a crowd-pleasing appetizer of crispy fried Samosas with a creamy potato pea filling and a spicy main course of pork vindaloo.

programme.title: The Kitchen
programme.desc: 'S37/E14 - Fall's Finest'. The hosts create a cozy menu of fall's finest recipes, like a creamy seasonal soup, a showstopping tenderloin and an impressive pear dessert.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: 'S36/E3 - Eastern Southern'. Guy Fieri heads east to get a taste of the South. He checks out meatloaf in New Hampshire, extra-spicy shrimp in North Carolina and seafood stew in Florida.

programme.title: Chopped
programme.desc: 'S55/E17 - Too Yacht To Handle'. Chefs who usually cook on yachts trade their sea legs for a topsy-turvy experience in the kitchen! Rough waters in the appetiser round make for a rocky start.

programme.title: Restaurant Impossible: Last Call
programme.desc: 'S1/E4 - Family Heat'. A Mexican restaurant suffocates under debt and a matriarch clinging to outworn ideas while her chef son is trying to save his mother's life's work.

programme.title: Kitchen Undercover
programme.desc: 'S1/E1 - Broke Spirits'. Antonia and Nestor go undercover in a once-booming BBQ joint that is about to go bust if they can't clean up the kitchen and the staff's attitudes.

programme.title: Last Bite Hotel
programme.desc: 'S1/E3 - Oodles Of Noodles'. Tituss Burgess asks the remaining chefs to create a noodle dish for Iron Chef Michael Symon. The bottom two chefs face off in a sudden-death round.

programme.title: Ready Jet Cook
programme.desc: 'S3/E3 - Chinese-American Takeout'. Jet Tila makes two Chinese-American icons from scratch, beef and broccoli and sesame chicken, while sharing wok tips, velveting techniques, and more.

programme.title: Spring Baking Championship
programme.desc: 'S9/E7 - The Things We Bake For Love'. The bakers try to woo the judges with delicious desserts baked from the heart. They create breakfast-in-bed muffin towers and decadent chocolate pies.

programme.title: Spring Baking Championship
programme.desc: 'S9/E8 - Love Around The World'. The bakers celebrate their love for the flavours of the world. They create blind date mashup desserts and exotic cheesecakes.

programme.title: Triple D Nation: Coastal Cuisine
programme.desc: Guy Fieri hits up some ultimate dining spots by the shore. First, he's in Honolulu to meet an old buddy reeling in fresh poke. And in San Diego he visits a fresh fish market.

programme.title: Triple D Nation: Fried, Baked...
programme.desc: 'Triple D Nation: Fried, Baked And Barbecued'. Guy Fieri visits a San Diego diner where law enforcement hones their skills. Then, in Phoenix, a Triple D legend serves up a Mexican-Asian mashup that has never been matched.

programme.title: Flavortown Food Fight
programme.desc: 'S1/E1 - Inaugural Food Fight'. Angelo Sosa, Kayla Pfeiffer, and Trimell Hawkins kick off the competition for a chance to win up to $20,000 and continue their run through Flavortown.

programme.title: Alex Vs America
programme.desc: 'S4/E5 - Alex vs Southwest'. Three chefs from Arizona, New Mexico and Texas show Alex Guarnaschelli the best of the Southwest in two spicy rounds of competition.

programme.title: Winner Cake All
programme.desc: 'S1/E2 - Darci Lynne's Birthday'. Four of the best baking teams in America compete against each other in different creative cake challenges. The winning team leaves with $10,000 prize money.
